name: mplus_get_account
title: Get the Microstock+ account
description: Get the Microstock+ account behind the configured agent key: plan, balance in EUR (null when not reported), connected stock agencies with the agency ids the other tools expect (for example adobestock = Adobe Stock, esp = iStock, shutterstock, pond5), keyword settings, API limits, and the key's name, prefix and scopes (what this key may do). Call it first in a session. Read-only.

summary.description: What happened and what to do next.

name: mplus_list_folders
title: List Microstock+ folders
description: List the user's Microstock+ folders as a flat tree: path, number of files and subfolders, and per-agency status counts (for example how many files are ready or submitted on Adobe Stock). Use it to find where files are before listing them. Archived folders are left out unless archived=true. Read-only; pass next_cursor as cursor for the next page.

path.description: List this folder's subfolders. Default / (all folders).

recursive.description: Include nested subfolders at every depth. Default true.

archived.description: true lists archived folders instead of active ones. Default false.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous result of the same call.

summary.description: What happened and what to do next.

name: mplus_list_files
title: List or search Microstock+ files
description: List or search the user's files with their metadata, metaver and per-agency status. Filters: folder (with recursive), free-text search or a list of iids, media type, agency + status (for example agency adobestock, status ready), missing fields (find files without a title, description, keywords or categories) and keyword count (max_keywords 6 finds files that Shutterstock would refuse). Descriptions are included only with expand_metadata=true. Returns up to limit files (default 25; keep it at 50 or less unless you need more); pass next_cursor as cursor for the next page. Read-only.

folder.description: Folder to list. Default / (the top folder).

recursive.description: Include files in all subfolders. Default true; pass false for only this folder.

search.description: Text to find in file names, titles and keywords.

items.description: File id (iid) from mplus_list_files, for example 6abc74e948864d403ea0c559.

type.description: Media type: raster (photos and raster illustrations), vector or video.

agency.description: Agency id from mplus_get_account, for example adobestock (Adobe Stock), shutterstock, esp (iStock) or pond5.

status.description: Status on the given agency; requires agency.

missing.description: Only files that lack any of these fields.

min_keywords.description: Only files with at least this many keywords.

max_keywords.description: Only files with at most this many keywords.

archived.description: true lists archived files instead of active ones. Default false.

updated_since.description: Only files changed since this ISO-8601 time, for example 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous result of the same call.

summary.description: What happened and what to do next.

name: mplus_get_previews
title: Get Microstock+ file previews
description: Load authenticated previews for 1-8 files from the key owner's portfolio. Returns native MCP image blocks for visual clients plus a small ordered manifest for every IID, including processing or unavailable errors. Use list pagination first, then request previews in batches; no bearer token or private CDN URL is exposed. Read-only.

items.description: File id (iid) from mplus_list_files, for example 6abc74e948864d403ea0c559.

iids.description: File iids in the order the previews should be returned.

summary.description: What happened and what to do next.

name: mplus_resolve_istock_terms
title: Resolve iStock keyword terms
description: For 1-10 owner files, resolve each stored keyword against the iStock/Getty controlled vocabulary. Returns candidate ids and labels, existing selections, metaver and a signed candidate_set_id. Look at the file previews and choose exactly one offered id per keyword by meaning; never invent ids. A pending file has no candidate_set_id and must be resolved again later. This lookup is read-only and does not run paid Microstock+ AI.

items.description: File id (iid) from mplus_list_files, for example 6abc74e948864d403ea0c559.

locale.description: Controlled-vocabulary locale. Only en is supported; default en.

summary.description: What happened and what to do next.

name: mplus_set_istock_terms
title: Set iStock keyword terms
description: Validate or save controlled-vocabulary selections for 1-10 iStock files. Use only candidate ids returned by mplus_resolve_istock_terms with the same iid, metaver and candidate_set_id. Start with dry_run=true, show the exact keyword-to-label choices, obtain the user's request to save, then repeat with dry_run=false. This writes metadata only; it does not submit files, run paid AI or choose candidates for you.

dry_run.description: true validates without saving; always do this first.

stock.description: Same stock used when resolving. Default esp.

locale.description: Only en is supported; default en.

iid.description: File id (iid) from mplus_list_files, for example 6abc74e948864d403ea0c559.

if_match_metaver.description: The file's metaver when you read it. The change fails with metadata_conflict if the file changed since.

candidate_set_id.description: Signed candidate set returned by mplus_resolve_istock_terms.

selections.description: Map each original keyword to exactly one term id offered for it by mplus_resolve_istock_terms.

summary.description: What happened and what to do next.

name: mplus_get_file
title: Get one Microstock+ file
description: Get one file by iid with its full metadata (title, description, keywords in order, categories, editorial, AI-generated and illustration flags, releases, notes), its metaver (needed for safe updates), an authenticated inline preview image, and for every agency its status, upload and submission times, errors and validation warnings (for example "Less than 7 keywords" on Shutterstock). Read-only.

iid.description: File id (iid) from mplus_list_files, for example 6abc74e948864d403ea0c559.

summary.description: What happened and what to do next.

name: mplus_update_metadata
title: Update one file's metadata
description: Change one file's metadata after inspecting its authenticated preview. For stock metadata use a natural title of at most 70 characters, an accurate media-specific description, and exactly 50 unique relevant English master keywords with the strongest 10 first; never silently cut the master to 49 for one agency. Only passed fields change. Pass if_match_metaver so a newer edit is not overwritten. ai_generated=true also sets editorial=false. Returns the updated row, but re-read the file after apply for fresh per-agency validation; dry-run validation may still reflect old metadata. Uploads and submits nothing. For several files use mplus_update_metadata_batch.

iid.description: File id (iid) from mplus_list_files, for example 6abc74e948864d403ea0c559.

if_match_metaver.description: The file's metaver when you read it. The change fails with metadata_conflict if the file changed since.

title.description: New title, at most 200 characters: a plain, specific sentence about what is shown.

description.description: New description. Some agencies (Shutterstock, Adobe Stock) allow 200 characters; longer text is reported as validation, not cut.

name: mplus_update_metadata_batch
title: Update metadata of many files
description: Change the metadata of up to 100 files in one call. Each item is {iid, patch, if_match_metaver} and patch takes the same fields as mplus_update_metadata. Always call with dry_run=true first: it checks every item and returns the would-be metadata and agency validation without writing anything. Show the user the planned changes, then call again with dry_run=false. Items succeed or fail on their own; failed items (for example metadata_conflict when a file changed since your metaver) are listed with their error and stay unchanged.

name: mplus_set_status
title: Set agency status (queue uploads)
description: Set one agency status for up to 100 files. Use ready only after a fresh post-apply read shows a mutable pre-submission state and clean agency validation; preserve ignored/held, queue/progress, submitted/review, failed/rejected/approved, scheduled, cannotbequeued and nosubmissions states unless the owner explicitly targets them. ready means prepared and does not submit. queued uploads and submits, so pass user_confirmed=true only when the conversation explicitly authorizes these exact files and agency; existing authorization remains valid. Failures are reported per file and agency.

items.description: File id (iid) from mplus_list_files, for example 6abc74e948864d403ea0c559.

agency.description: Agency id from mplus_get_account, for example adobestock (Adobe Stock), shutterstock, esp (iStock) or pond5.

status.description: ready, queued (upload and submit) or ignored.

user_confirmed.description: Required true for queued: the user explicitly approved sending these files to this agency.

name: mplus_create_folder
title: Create a Microstock+ folder
description: Create one folder in the key owner's Microstock+ portfolio so local files can be uploaded into it. Pass the complete directory path beginning with /. This cannot delete, rename or overwrite a folder or file.

directory.description: Folder path starting with /, for example /foto/2026.

summary.description: What happened and what to do next.

name: mplus_initialize_upload
title: Initialize a Microstock+ file upload
description: Create a short-lived upload ticket for one local file. The named Microstock+ directory must already exist. After this call, transfer the local binary directly to upload.chunk.url with the returned method, form_fields and file_field, then call upload.finish. This tool never accepts or fetches a remote URL, and it cannot delete or replace an existing file.

filename.description: File name only, without a path.

size_bytes.description: Exact local file size in bytes.

content_type.description: MIME type such as image/jpeg, image/png, application/zip or video/mp4.

directory.description: Folder path starting with /, for example /foto/2026.

summary.description: What happened and what to do next.

name: mplus_export_csv
title: Export metadata as CSV
description: Build a metadata CSV (the same layouts as Export CSV in My Files) for up to 500 files, from a list of iids or a folder. Formats: default (filename, description, keywords, categories, release files), with_title (adds the title), importable (for re-import into Microstock+), with_release_names (release names instead of files), without_categories, nimia (Nimia footage template), alamy (Alamy video template). Delimiter comma (for agencies) or semicolon (for Excel). Returns a download_url that works with the agent key until expires_at; include_csv=true also returns the CSV text (up to about 250 KB) so you can save it as a file. Free; changes nothing.

items.description: File id (iid) from mplus_list_files, for example 6abc74e948864d403ea0c559.

recursive.description: With folder: include subfolders. Default false.

delimiter.description: comma (for agencies, default) or semicolon (for Excel).

include_csv.description: Also return the CSV text. Default false.

summary.description: What happened and what to do next.

csv.description: The CSV text, when include_csv was true and it fit.

csv_omitted_reason.description: Why the CSV text is not included although include_csv was true.

name: mplus_wait_for_events
title: Wait for account events
description: Wait up to wait_seconds (at most 25) for new events on the user's account and return them. Microstock+ currently reports the changes made through the Agent API (metadata updates and exports) and agent key changes; upload, submission and review events are not reported yet. Returns as soon as events arrive. Without cursor it starts with the most recent events; pass the returned next_cursor as cursor to continue exactly where you left off. Filter with types. Use it to confirm what changed and to report progress. Read-only.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous mplus_wait_for_events result.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for new events, 0-25. Default 25.
